Systems Engineering Process Model

Digital Systems Engineering Process Model Version 1.1 Published: September 2026

An official INCOSE technical product • Interactive reference architecture based on ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288

Welcome to the Interactive Process Model. This digital handbook provides an interactive environment representing system life-cycle processes. Explore process purposes, drill down into detailed inputs and outputs, and execute direct SQL queries against the underlying architectural dataset.

Official INCOSE Product Page

Navigation & Application Notes

1. Navigating Processes & Views
  1. In the Model Tree on the left, expand Views and select 01 - System Life-Cycle Processes.
  2. Click on any process, activity, or artefact directly on the diagram to display its formal definition and attributes in the inspector pane.
  3. To inspect the detailed inputs and outputs of a specific process, click the embedded sub-view icon located directly on the process element.
  4. To return to the overarching landscape, select the root overview view from the tree.
2. Searching the Model

Use the built-in search bar located at the top of the Model Tree pane (magnifying glass icon ).

  • Type any keyword, process name, or artefact identifier.
  • The tree automatically filters matched elements across all model layers in real time without requiring manual expansion of folders.
3. Executing SQL Queries

The report runs on an in-memory SQL database (AlaSQL) compiled directly from the model metadata.

  1. Switch to the Query tab in the navigation bar above.
  2. Enter SQL queries against Archi tables (e.g. dataElements, dataProperties, dataRelationships).
  3. For detailed database schemas and syntax examples, consult the Archi Wiki: SQL queries in HTML reports.
4. Feedback & Contact

For inquiries, suggestions, or technical feedback regarding this model, please contact the author via email: alexander@efremov-systems.com.

Changelog

Version 1.1
  • Migrated to the updated Archi HTML export engine, introducing integrated real-time search directly inside the Model Tree.
  • Resolved missing input dependency: added the Business requirements business object as a formal input to the Stakeholder Needs and Requirements Definition process.
Version 1.0
Initial release (18.04.2023). Complete interactive mapping of ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288:2015 processes, activities, inputs, and outputs.

de_PurposeDas ist das interaktive Systems Engineering Prozessmodell - ein Teil des Produktes der Gesellschaft für Systems Engineering (GfSE, German INCOSE Chapter). ANWENDUNGSHINWEISE Navigation über Ansichte: - im "Model Tree": "Views" aufklappen, die Ansicht "01 - Systemlebenszyklusprozesse" auswählen; - für detaillierte Beschreibung der Einheiten im interaktiven Prozessmodell die Einheit (den Prozess, den Input oder den Output) auf der Ansicht mit linke Maustaste auswählen; - für die Ansicht mit Inputs und Outputs auf das blaue Quadrat neben dem Prozessnamen klicken; - für die Ansicht mit der Auflistung der Prozesse das blaue Rechteck mit dem Ansichtnamen "01 - Systemlebenszyklusprozesse" klicken. Suche in der Liste der Einheiten im Prozessmodell: - im "Model Tree": "Model Content - Business" aufklappen, Suche-Funktion im Browser aktivieren (Strg+F für Windows), den Namen der Einheit tippen; - die gefundene Einheit mit Mouseclick auswählen. en_Purpose*** Welcome to the Digital Systems Engineering Process Model - Product of INCOSE *** This report was generated by a model in HTML format. It serves as an interactive handbook, allowing users to click on individual processes to learn more about their purpose. By clicking on the blue square within each process, users can delve deeper to review the process's inputs, outputs, and definition. Additionally, users have the option to execute SQL queries to obtain a subset of the database that underlies the report. The source model, available in .archimate-file format for Archi tool, xml-file in the Open Exchange Format, or .csv-files, can be downloaded and modified with a preferred tool. https://github.com/alef1986/Systems-Engineering-Process-Model Please take note of the Application and Copyright notes provided below. Created by: Alexander Efremov, CSEP, SE-ZERT B alexander.efremoff@gmail.com; https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexander-efremov-88b65b28/ *** Application notes *** To navigate through the interactive process model, follow these steps: 1. In the "Model Tree," expand "Views" and select the view titled "01 - System Life Cycle Processes." 2. To obtain a detailed description of the units within the model (including processes, inputs, and outputs), click on the unit of interest using the left mouse button. 3. To view the inputs and outputs associated with a specific process, click on the blue square located next to the process name. 4. To view the list of processes within the "01 - System Life Cycle Processes" view, click on the blue rectangle associated with this view. To search for a specific unit within the process model, follow these steps: 1. In the "Model Tree," expand "Model Content - Business." 2. Activate the search function in your browser by pressing Ctrl+F (for Windows). 3. Type the name of the unit you are searching for in the search bar. 4. Use the mouse to select the unit found by the search function. To execute SQL queries within the process model, follow these steps: 1. Click on "Query" located under "Systems Engineering Process Model." 2. Type in your query. Please note that knowledge of the data structure of the Archi tool is required for this step. For more information on SQL queries in the HTML report, please see the Archi Wiki at https://github.com/archimatetool/archi/wiki/SQL-queries-in-the-HTML-report. To contact the author or report an issue: 1. follow the link on GitHub: https://git.io/JTFMF *** Copyright notes *** Different parts of this product have different copyright owners.
